set.body: Close the lifecycle migration only after APIs, laws, runtime evidence, IR and documentation agree. Acceptance: compileAll and testAll pass warning-clean on JVM and Scala.js from a clean detached worktree; all model-family capability and maturity records resolve; old SolverGuarantee, hand-authored evidence and pre-lifecycle fit constructors are removed or explicitly versioned adapters; conformance fixtures cover reference tampering and family mismatch; examples demonstrate spectral, GLRM and aligned multiblock fit to ModelSpec to IR.
set.title: Release-gate the unified multivar lifecycle and remove legacy construction paths
